sloka: दुद्रुवुर्बहुधा भीता राक्षसाः शतशो दिशः।त्यक्त्वा प्रहरणान् सर्वे पट्टिशासिपरश्वधान् ।। ६.९१.८१ ।।
transliteration: dudruvurbahudhā bhītā rākṣasāḥ śataśo diśaḥ।tyaktvā praharaṇān sarve paṭṭiśāsiparaśvadhān ।। 6.91.81 ।।

translations.english: All Rakshasas feared and panic stricken fled in hundreds, in groups in all directions leaving their sharpedged spears, swords, and axes.
